Comparing the monthly cost of the membership ($10) with the estimated monthly cost of paying per ride (11.15 minutes * ($0.15 + $0.35) = $5.35), the riders would save money by opting for the monthly membership.

Therefore, the recommendation is to 'Buy Monthly Membership'.

2. The pricing information is accurate and up-to-date.
